title: Recent/persistent projects in browser: autosave to IndexedDB so F5 restores, named Save As slots + Open Recent, reopen on reload
description: USER FEATURE: track projects in the browser so a refresh (F5) does not lose work; 'Save As' names the project in storage and reloads back into it. EXPLORE FIRST (cite file:line): the save/load path (packages/core/src/fla saveFla/loadFla + serialize/deserialize), useFileActions.ts (Save/Save As/Open, isTauri() pattern, web download/upload vs Tauri @tauri-apps/plugin-fs/dialog), how the active document + its name/title are held (documentStore / uiStore / title bar), the existing browser-storage patterns (IndexedDB usage from the AS2 class VFS in authoring-ui/src/vfs + core/vfs; preferences.ts/editorLayout.ts/threadStore.ts localStorage hygiene), and MenuBar.tsx File menu. IMPLEMENT (web/non-Tauri is the priority since F5-loss is a web problem): (1) A projects store in IndexedDB (projects can be multi-MB with embedded bitmaps/sounds, so NOT localStorage) keyed by project name, storing the serialized project (reuse saveFla serialization to bytes) + metadata {name, updatedAt, sizeBytes, optional small stage thumbnail}. (2) AUTOSAVE: debounce (~1-2s) the active document to a 'current working' slot on changes so F5 restores the exact in-progress state (not just the last manual save). On app load, restore the last-active project from that slot (or the last-opened named project); if storage is empty, start a new doc as today. (3) SAVE AS <name>: store under that name, set it as the active project name (reflected in the title bar), and autosave there going forward; reload reopens that named project. Plain Save updates the active named slot. (4) OPEN RECENT: a recent-projects list (most-recent first, capped e.g. 15) surfaced in the File menu (and optionally a welcome/start list); selecting one loads it. Include delete-from-recent. (5) Graceful storage hygiene: quota/parse failure fallback (mirror existing stores), schema version for migration, cap recent count. (6) TAURI (your call — keep sensible, do not over-engineer): on desktop, projects are real .fla files; track recent FILE PATHS and reopen the last path on launch (the IndexedDB autosave is the web mechanism). Use isTauri() to branch; don't break desktop Save/Open. VERIFY: build + authoring-ui/core tests green (only ~3 task-1207 fixture failures acceptable); unit tests for the IndexedDB project store round-trip (fake-indexeddb), autosave debounce, Save-As naming, recent-list cap/dedup, restore-on-load, quota/parse fallback; ideally a Playwright e2e (edit -> reload -> restored; Save As name -> reload -> reopens named project). Update docs/. ACQUIRE lock; commit incl task file; push rebase-retry (if .tasks/.counter conflicts, keep origin's — your task token is unique). Scope: new projectStore (IndexedDB) + autosave hook + useFileActions/MenuBar (Save As/Open Recent) + Shell restore-on-load + title (+tests). NOTE: two read-only audits are running on AS2/Live-Preview code — no conflict with your save/load/menu/storage scope.
